source.retrieval: The published family list from https://api.fontshare.com/v2/fonts, fetched once; for each family listed as SIL OFL, the family download was read in memory and only its License/ text file was hashed. No font binaries were kept. ITF FFL families were not downloaded.
source.licence: Fontshare separates SIL OFL families from Indian Type Foundry FFL originals; a family is OFL here only when its own licence file says so
source.notes: Licence sha256 is the digest of the family licence file bytes. Notice sha256 is the digest of the copyright lines from that file, joined by newlines. listingRecordSha256 is the digest of the family listing fields kept here, serialised canonically.
